articles.title: AI First
articles.rule: Use AI to analyse, explain and recommend while preserving human control.

articles.title: Configuration over Hardcoding
articles.rule: Business rules must originate from configuration or explicit contracts.

articles.title: Behaviour before Components
articles.rule: Validate complete behaviour chains, including forbidden outcomes.

articles.title: Human Approval for Risk
articles.rule: High-impact actions require explicit human approval.

articles.title: Explainability Required
articles.rule: Every automated verdict must include reason and evidence.

articles.title: Registered Capabilities
articles.rule: Every platform capability must be registered with owner and dependencies.

articles.title: Contracted Behaviour
articles.rule: Every user-visible capability must have a behaviour contract.

articles.title: Release Integrity
articles.rule: Every release must prove feature, impact and platform consistency.

articles.title: Controlled Complexity
articles.rule: Complexity increases require justification and registered technical debt.

articles.title: No Vendor Lock-in
articles.rule: Features request capabilities and must not depend directly on a specific AI provider.
